question: which frame do the directions of product g carry? (Suhl-Chat, 13.11.2026)

answer.az (building, ridge): model frame: clockwise from the model +y axis, 0 <= az < 180 - as schema g.py defines it
answer.R[].az (roof face, downhill): from true north, 0 <= az < 360 - as schema g.py defines it
answer.why: model axes turned 4.3566 deg against the UTM grid, meridian convergence at Suhl +1.3082 deg

how: tools/suhl/gebaeude/pruefen.py, checks "ridge az in the model frame" and "face az from true north": long gable roofs (r = 2) over a clean rectangle (long side >= 8 m and >= 2 x the short side, footprint fills >= 90 % of its smallest rectangle); the ridge against the long axis of the footprint in tile-local model metres; every face against the downhill direction of its own triangles (rv/rt); and both against the geodesic azimuth of the long axis (pyproj, GRS80), which does not use the constants of this package
